correctness.rationale: For d≥2, q_i≥2 and both parity classes represented, A over F₂ of the Cartesian product of loopless complete graphs equals (d mod 2)I+Σ J_i. For odd q_i, J_i is projector; parity sectors contribute multiplicity (P+(-1)^d R)/2. For even q_i, J_i²=0 and rank one, their tensor sum D has D²=0, and each rank-two Jordan factor is contractible; only tensor product of (q_i−2)-dimensional trivial homology components survives, dimension H, yielding dim ker D=(Q+H)/2. Product formula dim ker A=(Q+H)(P+(-1)^dR)/4 follows. Direct GF₂ Gaussian elimination for 210 mixed-parity tuples with q_i∈2..5 and d∈2..4, N≤160, agrees with formula; not an infinite proof. For fully oriented edges, B+Bᵀ=A and Riera–Parker–Stănică Lemma4.1 gives e=rank(A)/2, independent orientation. Connected graph alternating binary adjacency rank even; denominator integral even at q_even=2.
